gloss: to have trouble; to struggle; to go through hardship

definitions.gloss: to have trouble; to struggle; to go through hardship
definitions.explanation: To experience difficulty, suffering, or hardship in accomplishing something or in life circumstances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{苦労|くろう}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{苦労|くろう}して⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: My mother raised me on her own through hardship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{敬語|けいご}→敬語：04022_keigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{苦労|くろう}させられる。
examples.english: Japanese honorific language gives me no end of trouble.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦せよ→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Seek out hardship while you are young. (proverb)

notes:
An extremely common word in everyday Japanese. Implies sustained difficulty rather than a single moment of trouble. The noun ⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧ alone is also very frequent. Can express both sympathy and respect for someone's efforts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絶|た}えない→絶える：13814_taeru⟧: to have no end of troubles
- ご⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧さま: thanks for your hard work (used toward subordinates)
- ⟦{苦労|くろう}{人|にん}→苦労人：15661_kurounin⟧: a person who has been through hardship
- ⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{報|むく}われる: one's efforts are rewarded
- ⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}ける: to cause someone trouble

USAGE:
ご⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧さま is typically used by a superior to a subordinate. Saying it to a boss or senior would be impolite. Use お{疲|つか}れさま instead when speaking to equals or superiors.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧: to be troubled — focuses on being in a bind, not long-term suffering
- ⟦{悩|なや}む→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧: to worry — focuses on mental anguish and indecision
- ⟦{努力|どりょく}する→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧: to make an effort — positive emphasis on trying hard, not on suffering
